---
title: Send Soroban token payments
description: Send a smart contract token payment directly from Varial
---

Once you have added a Soroban token to your Varial wallet, you can now send a payment of that token directly from Varial.

1. On the Varial account screen, click the `Send` icon in the upper part of the screen.

2. Enter a recipient public key. Click `Continue`.

3. Select your token from the asset list at the bottom of the screen and enter a token amount. Click `Continue`.

4. Enter a memo (optional). Click `Review Send`.

5. Review the details of your payment. Click `Send`.
